# SmoothCast error catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/ci/gen_errors_doc.py from src/errors.py. Do not edit. -->

Every failure a person can see has a stable code, a plain message and ordered steps.
Codes are never translated. See [UX copy](UX_COPY.md) for the voice.

<a id="errors-cast-receiver-offline"></a>
## `cast.receiver_offline`

- Severity: error; retryable: yes
- Message: Receiver offline. Check its power and network connection.
- Try:
  1. Check that the receiver is switched on.
  2. Check that it is on the same network as this computer.
  3. Choose the receiver again from the list.

<a id="errors-cast-command-in-progress"></a>
## `cast.command_in_progress`

- Severity: info; retryable: yes
- Message: SmoothCast is finishing another command. Wait a moment, then retry.
- Try:
  1. Wait a few seconds.
  2. Retry the action.

<a id="errors-cast-playback-changed"></a>
## `cast.playback_changed`

- Severity: info; retryable: yes
- Message: Playback changed. Refresh the room before retrying.
- Try:
  1. Refresh the room.
  2. Retry the action if it still applies.

<a id="errors-ffmpeg-too-old"></a>
## `ffmpeg.too_old`

- Severity: error; retryable: no
- Message: FFmpeg is too old or missing. SmoothCast needs FFmpeg 5.0 or newer.
- Try:
  1. Install FFmpeg 5.0 or newer.
  2. Restart SmoothCast.

<a id="errors-media-unavailable"></a>
## `media.unavailable`

- Severity: warning; retryable: no
- Message: That media is no longer available. Choose it again.
- Try:
  1. Check that the file still exists and its drive is connected.
  2. Add it to Up Next again.

<a id="errors-room-session-expired"></a>
## `room.session_expired`

- Severity: info; retryable: yes
- Message: Your room session ended. Join the room again.
- Try:
  1. Reload the page.
  2. Enter your name to rejoin.

<a id="errors-room-queue-item-gone"></a>
## `room.queue_item_gone`

- Severity: info; retryable: yes
- Message: That Up Next item is no longer there. Refresh the room.
- Try:
  1. Refresh the room to see the current Up Next.

<a id="errors-room-rate-limited"></a>
## `room.rate_limited`

- Severity: info; retryable: yes
- Message: Too many commands in a short time. Try again shortly.
- Try:
  1. Wait a few seconds.
  2. Retry the action.

<a id="errors-upload-not-found"></a>
## `upload.not_found`

- Severity: warning; retryable: yes
- Message: Upload not found. Choose the file again.
- Try:
  1. Choose the file again to restart the upload.

<a id="errors-upload-disk-full"></a>
## `upload.disk_full`

- Severity: error; retryable: no
- Message: Not enough free space to receive this file. Free some space, then retry.
- Try:
  1. Free disk space on the computer running SmoothCast.
  2. Retry the upload.

<a id="errors-app-shutting-down"></a>
## `app.shutting_down`

- Severity: info; retryable: no
- Message: SmoothCast is shutting down. Reconnect when it has restarted.
- Try:
  1. Wait for SmoothCast to start again.
  2. Reload the page.

<a id="errors-internal-unexpected"></a>
## `internal.unexpected`

- Severity: error; retryable: yes
- Message: SmoothCast hit an unexpected problem. Retry the action.
- Try:
  1. Retry the action.
  2. If it keeps happening, use Report a problem in the Help menu.
